neutralDescription.en: Choosing to contact the castle from a Bracer Guild (you cannot roam Liberl afterwards)
neutralDescription.pt: Escolher contatar o castelo em uma guilda (depois disso não dá mais para percorrer Liberl)

neutralDescription.en: The last event marker of Chapter 8
neutralDescription.pt: O último marcador de evento do Capítulo 8

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP, +1 BP bonus. A fetch quest that crosses half of Liberl. Pick the third option (the embassy) when asked, to earn the extra BP. Grancel has to be reached on foot first, so leave the Bezoar for when you pass through there.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP, +1 BP de bônus. Uma quest de busca que cruza metade de Liberl. Escolha a terceira opção (a embaixada) quando perguntarem, para ganhar o BP extra. Grancel precisa ser alcançada a pé antes, então deixe o Bezoar para quando passar por lá.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Bose
guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Grancel

text.en: Talk to Lugran at the Bose guild, then to Sting in Ravennue Village, then go back to the guild.
text.pt: Fale com Lugran na guilda de Bose, depois com Sting em Ravennue Village e volte à guilda.

text.en: Choose the third option, "Calvard Embassy", for the bonus BP.
text.pt: Escolha a terceira opção, "Calvard Embassy", para o BP de bônus.

text.en: Dragon Claw: talk to Orvid in Anterose Restaurant, go to Nebel Valley, fast travel to the entrance of Ancient Dragon's Lair and examine the plant at the north end of the boss room.
text.pt: Dragon Claw: fale com Orvid no Anterose Restaurant, vá a Nebel Valley, use a viagem rápida até a entrada de Ancient Dragon's Lair e examine a planta no extremo norte da sala do boss.

text.en: Ox Bezoar: in Grancel, ask Ambassador Cochrane at the Calvard Embassy (East Block), follow her to the shop in the West Block, between the Cathedral and Baral Coffee House, and buy it for 5,000 mira.
text.pt: Ox Bezoar: em Grancel, fale com a embaixadora Cochrane na Calvard Embassy (East Block), siga-a até a loja no West Block, entre a Cathedral e o Baral Coffee House, e compre por 5.000 mira.

text.en: Hand both items to Spence in the Bose Market.
text.pt: Entregue os dois itens a Spence no Bose Market.

overview.en: A fetch quest that crosses half of Liberl. Pick the third option (the embassy) when asked, to earn the extra BP.
overview.pt: Uma quest de busca que cruza metade de Liberl. Escolha a terceira opção (a embaixada) quando perguntarem, para ganhar o BP extra.

warnings.en: Grancel has to be reached on foot first, so leave the Bezoar for when you pass through there.
warnings.pt: Grancel precisa ser alcançada a pé antes, então deixe o Bezoar para quando passar por lá.

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Mute II. Red Fangs, like the Blade Fangs of Chapter 5. They survive a lethal hit and enter Rage Boost near death, so keep an S-Break ready.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Mute II. Red Fangs, como os Blade Fangs do Capítulo 5. Sobrevivem a um golpe letal e entram em Rage Boost perto da morte, então guarde um S-Break.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Bose

overview.en: Red Fangs, like the Blade Fangs of Chapter 5. They survive a lethal hit and enter Rage Boost near death, so keep an S-Break ready.
overview.pt: Red Fangs, como os Blade Fangs do Capítulo 5. Sobrevivem a um golpe letal e entram em Rage Boost perto da morte, então guarde um S-Break.

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Burn II. Doom Type S with weak helpers. Their Double Tomahawk can cause Deathblow and All Cancel, and they enter Rage Boost under half HP. Delay and Stat Down work well.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Burn II. Doom Type S com ajudantes fracos. O Double Tomahawk pode causar Deathblow e All Cancel, e eles entram em Rage Boost com menos da metade do HP. Delay e Stat Down funcionam bem.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Bose

overview.en: Doom Type S with weak helpers. Their Double Tomahawk can cause Deathblow and All Cancel, and they enter Rage Boost under half HP. Delay and Stat Down work well.
overview.pt: Doom Type S com ajudantes fracos. O Double Tomahawk pode causar Deathblow e All Cancel, e eles entram em Rage Boost com menos da metade do HP. Delay e Stat Down funcionam bem.

location.en: Milch Main Road — northeast of the middle intersection
location.pt: Milch Main Road — nordeste do cruzamento do meio

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Confuse II. Devil Spears: nearly every attack poisons, and Deadly Poison Stinger can Deathblow. Block ailments with Debuff Immunity and budget an S-Break for their revive.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Confuse II. Devil Spears: quase todo ataque envenena, e o Deadly Poison Stinger pode causar Deathblow. Bloqueie os efeitos com Debuff Immunity e reserve um S-Break para a revivência deles.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

overview.en: Devil Spears: nearly every attack poisons, and Deadly Poison Stinger can Deathblow. Block ailments with Debuff Immunity and budget an S-Break for their revive.
overview.pt: Devil Spears: quase todo ataque envenena, e o Deadly Poison Stinger pode causar Deathblow. Bloqueie os efeitos com Debuff Immunity e reserve um S-Break para a revivência deles.

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Petrify II. Two Vanguards with five Vogel 911 EX. Burst the Vogels down with S-Breaks. Vanguards explode when destroyed, so keep your distance.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Petrify II. Dois Vanguards com cinco Vogel 911 EX. Derrube os Vogels rápido com S-Breaks. Os Vanguards explodem ao serem destruídos, então mantenha distância.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

overview.en: Two Vanguards with five Vogel 911 EX. Burst the Vogels down with S-Breaks. Vanguards explode when destroyed, so keep your distance.
overview.pt: Dois Vanguards com cinco Vogel 911 EX. Derrube os Vogels rápido com S-Breaks. Os Vanguards explodem ao serem destruídos, então mantenha distância.

hint.en: Reward: +9 BP. Rescue five trapped miners, then face the monster nest. Defeat at least one Baby Cancer on the way (see the battle entry below).
hint.pt: Recompensa: +9 BP. Resgate cinco mineiros presos e enfrente o ninho de monstros. Derrote ao menos um Baby Cancer no caminho (veja a entrada de batalha abaixo).

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

text.en: Hand in the Zero Field Generator at the Rolent guild to open Malga Trail.
text.pt: Entregue o Zero Field Generator na guilda de Rolent para abrir Malga Trail.

text.en: Enter Malga Mine, follow the rails, talk to the miners and ride the elevator down.
text.pt: Entre em Malga Mine, siga os trilhos, fale com os mineiros e desça pelo elevador.

text.en: Rescue Bones (southwest marker, four Killer Cancers).
text.pt: Resgate Bones (marcador sudoeste, quatro Killer Cancers).

text.en: Rescue Mine Chief Garton (south, four more Killer Cancers).
text.pt: Resgate o Mine Chief Garton (sul, mais quatro Killer Cancers).

text.en: Rescue Heine and Plim (southeast path, three Killer Cancers).
text.pt: Resgate Heine e Plim (caminho sudeste, três Killer Cancers).

text.en: Defeat the Armored Hydra in the nest to the northwest.
text.pt: Derrote a Armored Hydra no ninho a noroeste.

overview.en: Rescue five trapped miners, then face the monster nest. Defeat at least one Baby Cancer on the way (see the battle entry below).
overview.pt: Resgate cinco mineiros presos e enfrente o ninho de monstros. Derrote ao menos um Baby Cancer no caminho (veja a entrada de batalha abaixo).

requirements.en: The Rolent Bracer Guild must already have its Zero Field Generator.
requirements.pt: A guilda de Rolent já precisa ter recebido o Zero Field Generator.

location.en: Manoria Byroad — south route to Varenne Lighthouse
location.pt: Manoria Byroad — rota sul para Varenne Lighthouse

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Sleep II. Balancing Clowns, the same helpers Bleublanc had. They stack many ailments and rage at 75%, 50% and 25% HP. Debuff Immunity plus Joshua or Agate S-Breaks end it quickly.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Sleep II. Balancing Clowns, os mesmos ajudantes do Bleublanc. Acumulam vários efeitos e entram em fúria com 75%, 50% e 25% do HP. Debuff Immunity e S-Breaks do Joshua ou do Agate resolvem rápido.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

overview.en: Balancing Clowns, the same helpers Bleublanc had. They stack many ailments and rage at 75%, 50% and 25% HP. Debuff Immunity plus Joshua or Agate S-Breaks end it quickly.
overview.pt: Balancing Clowns, os mesmos ajudantes do Bleublanc. Acumulam vários efeitos e entram em fúria com 75%, 50% e 25% do HP. Debuff Immunity e S-Breaks do Joshua ou do Agate resolvem rápido.

location.en: Branch to Vista Forest Road, near Ruan
location.pt: Bifurcação para Vista Forest Road, perto de Ruan

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Cloak. A Rising Panda with four Sasa Pandas. Its Deathblow chance is much higher than the regular pandas'. Burst the small ones first, then buff and protect against its ailments.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Cloak. Um Rising Panda com quatro Sasa Pandas. A chance de Deathblow dele é bem maior que a dos pandas comuns. Derrube os pequenos primeiro e depois se proteja de seus efeitos.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

overview.en: A Rising Panda with four Sasa Pandas. Its Deathblow chance is much higher than the regular pandas'. Burst the small ones first, then buff and protect against its ailments.
overview.pt: Um Rising Panda com quatro Sasa Pandas. A chance de Deathblow dele é bem maior que a dos pandas comuns. Derrube os pequenos primeiro e depois se proteja de seus efeitos.

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Freeze II. Ebony Scales, a palette swap of the Guilder Quake. World Shaker hits everyone with Seal, Mute, Blind and AT Delay, so protect the party first.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Freeze II. Ebony Scales, uma variação do Guilder Quake. O World Shaker acerta todos com Seal, Mute, Blind e AT Delay, então proteja a equipe antes.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

overview.en: Ebony Scales, a palette swap of the Guilder Quake. World Shaker hits everyone with Seal, Mute, Blind and AT Delay, so protect the party first.
overview.pt: Ebony Scales, uma variação do Guilder Quake. O World Shaker acerta todos com Seal, Mute, Blind e AT Delay, então proteja a equipe antes.

hint.en: Reward: +9 BP and the Mighty Essence recipe. Joshua scouts the campus alone, then the party clears every building and frees the hostages before the final fight at the Old Schoolhouse.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +9 BP e a receita Mighty Essence. Joshua explora o campus sozinho; depois a equipe limpa todos os prédios e liberta os reféns antes da luta final no Old Schoolhouse.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

text.en: Hand in the Zero Field Generator at the Ruan guild, then go east to Vista Forest Road.
text.pt: Entregue o Zero Field Generator na guilda de Ruan e vá a leste, para Vista Forest Road.

text.en: As Joshua, look through the windows around the academy perimeter and unlock the Old Schoolhouse gate.
text.pt: Como Joshua, olhe pelas janelas ao redor do perímetro da academia e destrave o portão do Old Schoolhouse.

text.en: Clubhouse: win the second-floor fight; Deborah in the left room gives you Mighty Essence.
text.pt: Clubhouse: vença a luta do 2º andar; Deborah, na sala da esquerda, dá a Mighty Essence.

text.en: Main Building: win the fights on both floors and free the hostages.
text.pt: Main Building: vença as lutas nos dois andares e liberte os reféns.

text.en: Girl's Dorm and Boy's Dorm: win each fight, then enter the room on the left / right.
text.pt: Girl's Dorm e Boy's Dorm: vença cada luta e entre na sala da esquerda / direita.

text.en: Old Schoolhouse: free the last hostage and win the boss fight.
text.pt: Old Schoolhouse: liberte o último refém e vença a luta contra o boss.

rewards.en: +9 BP and the Mighty Essence recipe.
rewards.pt: +9 BP e a receita Mighty Essence.

overview.en: Joshua scouts the campus alone, then the party clears every building and frees the hostages before the final fight at the Old Schoolhouse.
overview.pt: Joshua explora o campus sozinho; depois a equipe limpa todos os prédios e liberta os reféns antes da luta final no Old Schoolhouse.

requirements.en: The Ruan Bracer Guild must already have its Zero Field Generator.
requirements.pt: A guilda de Ruan já precisa ter recebido o Zero Field Generator.

location.en: Kaldia Tunnel — south at the branch nearest Zeiss
location.pt: Kaldia Tunnel — sul, na bifurcação mais próxima de Zeiss

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Divine Cloth (needed for Divine Cloth Z). The Divine Pengu again, now alone. It survives one lethal blow; save an S-Break to finish it. It can Confuse the whole party, so wear Confuse protection.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Divine Cloth (necessário para a Divine Cloth Z). O Divine Pengu de novo, agora sozinho. Ele sobrevive a um golpe letal; guarde um S-Break para finalizar. Pode causar Confuse na equipe toda, então use proteção contra Confuse.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

rewards.en: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Divine Cloth (needed for Divine Cloth Z).
rewards.pt: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Divine Cloth (necessário para a Divine Cloth Z).

overview.en: The Divine Pengu again, now alone. It survives one lethal blow; save an S-Break to finish it. It can Confuse the whole party, so wear Confuse protection.
overview.pt: O Divine Pengu de novo, agora sozinho. Ele sobrevive a um golpe letal; guarde um S-Break para finalizar. Pode causar Confuse na equipe toda, então use proteção contra Confuse.

preparation.en: The tunnel is pitch dark: equip Night-Vision Goggles (sold by Paul Elk in the Bose Market).
preparation.pt: O túnel é totalmente escuro: equipe Night-Vision Goggles (vendidos por Paul Elk no Bose Market).

location.en: Tratt Plains Road — south of the way to Wolf Fort
location.pt: Tratt Plains Road — ao sul do caminho para Wolf Fort

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Poison II. Eight Abyss Worms that answer attacks with Earth-Shaker. Do not play it safe: spam Joshua and Agate S-Breaks with Burst until they fall.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Poison II. Oito Abyss Worms que respondem aos ataques com Earth-Shaker. Não jogue no seguro: use S-Breaks do Joshua e do Agate com Burst até derrubá-los.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

overview.en: Eight Abyss Worms that answer attacks with Earth-Shaker. Do not play it safe: spam Joshua and Agate S-Breaks with Burst until they fall.
overview.pt: Oito Abyss Worms que respondem aos ataques com Earth-Shaker. Não jogue no seguro: use S-Breaks do Joshua e do Agate com Burst até derrubá-los.

location.pt: Ritter Roadway — logo na saída de Zeiss

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Blind II. A Blade Cougar+ with seven Blade Cougars. Same plan as the Abyss Worms, but every cougar has Endure and needs an extra S-Break. Buff up if the strongest one survives.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Blind II. Um Blade Cougar+ com sete Blade Cougars. Mesmo plano das Abyss Worms, mas todos têm Endure e pedem um S-Break extra. Se o mais forte sobreviver, reforce os buffs.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

overview.en: A Blade Cougar+ with seven Blade Cougars. Same plan as the Abyss Worms, but every cougar has Endure and needs an extra S-Break. Buff up if the strongest one survives.
overview.pt: Um Blade Cougar+ com sete Blade Cougars. Mesmo plano das Abyss Worms, mas todos têm Endure e pedem um S-Break extra. Se o mais forte sobreviver, reforce os buffs.

hint.en: Reward: +9 BP, Ultra-Concentrated Herbal Tea ×4 and hot spring outfits. Find the two parts the village pump needs. Tita must be in the party, and the Zeiss guild must already have its Zero Field Generator.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +9 BP, Ultra-Concentrated Herbal Tea ×4 e roupas de fontes termais. Encontre as duas peças de que a bomba da vila precisa. A Tita precisa estar na equipe, e a guilda de Zeiss já precisa ter recebido o Zero Field Generator.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

text.en: Talk to Mao at the Maple Leaf Inn for the Pump Shed Key, then open the shed north of town with Tita in the party.
text.pt: Fale com Mao na Maple Leaf Inn para pegar a Pump Shed Key e abra o galpão ao norte da vila com a Tita na equipe.

text.en: Talk to Maintenance Chief Gustav at the Landing Port.
text.pt: Fale com o Maintenance Chief Gustav no porto de airships.

text.en: Ask Kilika at the Zeiss guild to contact Leiston Fortress.
text.pt: Peça à Kilika, na guilda de Zeiss, para contatar Leiston Fortress.

text.en: Talk to the Royal Army soldiers on Tratt Plains Road, south of Carnelia Tower: Combustion Engine.
text.pt: Fale com os soldados do Exército Real em Tratt Plains Road, ao sul da Carnelia Tower: Combustion Engine.

text.en: Talk to Rudi in the Zeiss Central Factory basement: Factory Chief Letter.
text.pt: Fale com Rudi no subsolo da Zeiss Central Factory: Factory Chief Letter.

text.en: Go to Ruan South Block (fast travel works), talk to Chief Portos, then to Harg further west: Gasoline Tank.
text.pt: Vá ao South Block de Ruan (a viagem rápida funciona), fale com o Chief Portos e depois com Harg, mais a oeste: Gasoline Tank.

text.en: Return to Elmo Village with Tita and finish the repair in the Pump Shed.
text.pt: Volte a Elmo Village com a Tita e conclua o conserto no Pump Shed.

rewards.en: +9 BP, Ultra-Concentrated Herbal Tea ×4 and hot spring outfits.
rewards.pt: +9 BP, Ultra-Concentrated Herbal Tea ×4 e roupas de fontes termais.

overview.en: Find the two parts the village pump needs. Tita must be in the party, and the Zeiss guild must already have its Zero Field Generator.
overview.pt: Encontre as duas peças de que a bomba da vila precisa. A Tita precisa estar na equipe, e a guilda de Zeiss já precisa ter recebido o Zero Field Generator.

location.en: Erbe Scenic Route — south of Erbe Royal Villa
location.pt: Erbe Scenic Route — ao sul da Erbe Royal Villa

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Seal II. A Big Cactus with seven Lark Cacti. Clear the small ones with S-Breaks, then guard against Poison, Blind and Confuse. It survives a lethal blow and rages at two-thirds and one-third HP.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Seal II. Um Big Cactus com sete Lark Cacti. Elimine os pequenos com S-Breaks e depois se proteja de Poison, Blind e Confuse. Ele sobrevive a um golpe letal e entra em fúria com dois terços e um terço do HP.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Grancel

overview.en: A Big Cactus with seven Lark Cacti. Clear the small ones with S-Breaks, then guard against Poison, Blind and Confuse. It survives a lethal blow and rages at two-thirds and one-third HP.
overview.pt: Um Big Cactus com sete Lark Cacti. Elimine os pequenos com S-Breaks e depois se proteja de Poison, Blind e Confuse. Ele sobrevive a um golpe letal e entra em fúria com dois terços e um terço do HP.

hint.en: Reward: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Elixir of Spirit. Three Evil Streams with low HP and many ailments. Attack first: fast kills avoid their drain moves and the party-capturing Dark Vacuum.
hint.pt: Recompensa: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Elixir of Spirit. Três Evil Streams com pouco HP e muitos efeitos. Ataque primeiro: matá-los rápido evita os golpes de drenagem e o Dark Vacuum, que captura membros da equipe.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Grancel

rewards.en: +5 BP. Guaranteed drop: Elixir of Spirit.
rewards.pt: +5 BP. Drop garantido: Elixir of Spirit.

overview.en: Three Evil Streams with low HP and many ailments. Attack first: fast kills avoid their drain moves and the party-capturing Dark Vacuum.
overview.pt: Três Evil Streams com pouco HP e muitos efeitos. Ataque primeiro: matá-los rápido evita os golpes de drenagem e o Dark Vacuum, que captura membros da equipe.

hint.en: Defeat at least one Baby Cancer on the field during Miners' Mayday, or it cannot be recorded in the handbook.
hint.pt: Derrote ao menos um Baby Cancer no campo durante Miners' Mayday, ou ele não poderá ser registrado no handbook.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

warnings.en: You will not return to the mine after the quest, so the entry is lost if you skip these fights.
warnings.pt: Você não volta à mina depois da quest, então a entrada se perde se você pular essas lutas.

name.en: Rewards that get harder after Liberl closes
name.pt: Recompensas que ficam mais difíceis quando Liberl se fecha

hint.en: Three in-game rewards need Liberl: winning medals at Lavantar Bar & Casino, cutting grass or flowers, and defeating enemies at once. Check your progress on them before contacting the castle.
hint.pt: Três recompensas do jogo dependem de Liberl: ganhar medalhas no Lavantar Bar & Casino, cortar grama ou flores e derrotar inimigos de uma vez. Confira seu progresso nelas antes de contatar o castelo.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Final Part

warnings.en: After the point of no return these become much harder or impossible.
warnings.pt: Depois do ponto sem volta elas ficam bem mais difíceis ou impossíveis.

overview.en: Winning medals at Lavantar Bar & Casino, cutting grass or flowers, and defeating enemies at once.
overview.pt: Ganhar medalhas no Lavantar Bar & Casino, cortar grama ou flores e derrotar inimigos de uma vez.

name.en: Final check before contacting the castle
name.pt: Conferência final antes de contatar o castelo

location.pt: Qualquer guilda de bracers, exceto a de Grancel

hint.en: After contacting the castle you cannot roam Liberl again. Compare your progress with the numbers below and cook the new recipes.
hint.pt: Depois de contatar o castelo você não percorre mais Liberl. Compare seu progresso com os números abaixo e cozinhe as receitas novas.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Final Part

text.en: 437 BP before the story quest (452 after it, Rank A).
text.pt: 437 BP antes da quest da história (452 depois, Rank A).

text.en: 67 of 70 recipes, 26 of 26 fish, 25 of 26 books, 435 of 566 treasure chests.
text.pt: 67 de 70 receitas, 26 de 26 peixes, 25 de 26 livros, 435 de 566 baús.

text.en: Cook every new recipe (80 of 87 dishes, 67 of 70 peculiar dishes). Flamboyant Candy Lei is not possible yet.
text.pt: Cozinhe todas as receitas novas (80 de 87 pratos, 67 de 70 pratos peculiares). Flamboyant Candy Lei ainda não é possível.

text.en: Buy monster ingredients from Orvid (about 30 of each) for the Final Chapter recipes.
text.pt: Compre ingredientes de monstros com Orvid (cerca de 30 de cada) para as receitas do Final Chapter.

text.en: Check the Combat Handbook: only the last Extra entry should be empty (Shining Poms, Dimension Bugs, Weatherseeds, Baby Cancer, Steel Cougar).
text.pt: Confira o Combat Handbook: só a última entrada de Extra deve estar vazia (Shining Poms, Dimension Bugs, Weatherseeds, Baby Cancer, Steel Cougar).

text.en: Farm sepith, mira and U-Material+ for Gem quartz and True Gems; caves and water caves are good spots.
text.pt: Faça farm de sepith, mira e U-Material+ para os quartzos Gem e True Gems; cavernas e cavernas com água são bons lugares.

preparation.en: Optional but helpful on Nightmare: four Kitty Jackets (O'Neil's Duty-Free Shop, Ruan) upgraded with Crescent Charms, and four Kitty Boots (Bell Station, Zeiss) upgraded with T-Anklets.
preparation.pt: Opcional, mas útil no Nightmare: quatro Kitty Jackets (O'Neil's Duty-Free Shop, Ruan) melhorados com Crescent Charms e quatro Kitty Boots (Bell Station, Zeiss) melhorados com T-Anklets.

optional.en: Farm T-Anklet+ and Crescent Charm+ from Shining Pom+ in Rolent and Bose, or by catching rank A Snakehead and Gigangora.
optional.pt: Faça farm de T-Anklet+ e Crescent Charm+ com Shining Pom+ em Rolent e Bose, ou pescando Snakehead e Gigangora de rank A.

overview.en: Use this list before choosing "Contact the castle" at any guild other than Grancel's.
overview.pt: Use esta lista antes de escolher "Contact the castle" em qualquer guilda que não seja a de Grancel.

location.en: Grancel — Edel Department Store, E. Block
location.pt: Grancel — Edel Department Store, E. Block

hint.en: Sold at the general goods section of the department store in the East Block.
hint.pt: Vendido na seção de produtos gerais da loja de departamentos do East Block.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Grancel

hint.en: Talk to Serra after finishing Miners' Mayday and watching the wedding at the chapel.
hint.pt: Fale com Serra depois de terminar Miners' Mayday e ver o casamento na capela.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

location.en: Ruan — Jenis Royal Academy, Main Building
location.pt: Ruan — Jenis Royal Academy, Main Building

hint.en: Talk to Violet after finishing Academy Attack.
hint.pt: Fale com Violet depois de terminar Academy Attack.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

hint.en: Talk to CWO Pace after finishing Hot Springs Salvation.
hint.pt: Fale com o CWO Pace depois de terminar Hot Springs Salvation.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

hint.en: Talk to Minuet once two Zero Field Generators have been delivered.
hint.pt: Fale com Minuet depois de entregar dois Zero Field Generators.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan
guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

location.en: Grancel — Baral Coffee House, W. Block
location.pt: Grancel — Baral Coffee House, W. Block

hint.en: Hand all 14 Gambler Jack volumes to Baral. The ore is only used in the Final Chapter to forge the strongest weapons. If you miss Baral here, he is on the guild's third floor after the point of no return.
hint.pt: Entregue os 14 volumes de Gambler Jack a Baral. O minério só é usado no Final Chapter para forjar as armas mais fortes. Se perder o Baral aqui, ele estará no 3º andar da guilda depois do ponto sem volta.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

strategy.en: Only pure-damage attacks. When they are about to die they use Indomitable Will and rage, so hold an S-Break for the revive.
strategy.pt: Só ataques de dano puro. Quando estão para morrer usam Indomitable Will e entram em fúria, então guarde um S-Break para a revivência.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Bose

strategy.en: Weak to Delay and Stat Down. Double Tomahawk can Deathblow and All Cancel; they rage below half HP.
strategy.pt: Fracos a Delay e Stat Down. O Double Tomahawk pode causar Deathblow e All Cancel; entram em fúria com menos da metade do HP.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Bose

strategy.en: Poison on nearly everything, plus Deathblow, All Cancel and a Venom Ring zone. Debuff Immunity first; keep an S-Break for their revive.
strategy.pt: Veneno em quase tudo, além de Deathblow, All Cancel e uma zona de Venom Ring. Debuff Immunity primeiro; guarde um S-Break para a revivência.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

strategy.en: The Vogels inflict Poison, Petrify, Burn, Seal and Blind and rage after losing a quarter of their HP. Kill them first with S-Breaks; the Vanguards explode when destroyed.
strategy.pt: Os Vogels causam Poison, Petrify, Burn, Seal e Blind e entram em fúria ao perder um quarto do HP. Elimine-os primeiro com S-Breaks; os Vanguards explodem ao serem destruídos.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

strategy.en: A stronger Abyss Worm. It always answers hits with Earth-Shaker (big party damage and AT Delay) and calls Killer Cancers. Shields and Debuff Immunity soften it; wipe the cancers with S-Breaks, then focus the Hydra before it rages.
strategy.pt: Uma Abyss Worm mais forte. Responde a golpes sempre com Earth-Shaker (muito dano na equipe e AT Delay) e chama Killer Cancers. Escudos e Debuff Immunity amenizam; elimine os cancers com S-Breaks e depois foque na Hydra antes da fúria.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Rolent

strategy.en: Seal, Mute, Blind, Confuse, AT Delay and All Cancel, and Dazzling Climax drains EP and CP. Debuff Immunity, then burst them down.
strategy.pt: Seal, Mute, Blind, Confuse, AT Delay e All Cancel, e o Dazzling Climax drena EP e CP. Debuff Immunity e depois derrube-os rápido.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

location.en: Near Ruan — Vista Forest Road branch
location.pt: Perto de Ruan — bifurcação de Vista Forest Road

strategy.en: Burst down the four Sasa Pandas, then buff with shields, Foresight and Debuff Immunity. It can rage with Requiem of the Panda if the fight drags on.
strategy.pt: Derrube rápido os quatro Sasa Pandas e depois use escudos, Foresight e Debuff Immunity. Pode entrar em fúria com Requiem of the Panda se a luta se arrastar.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

strategy.en: Heavy Tail Crush (AT Delay, Impede), World Shaker (Seal, Mute, Blind, AT Delay on everyone) and Ragna Blast (Seal). Be protected before it acts, and finish them before they rage.
strategy.pt: Heavy Tail Crush (AT Delay, Impede), World Shaker (Seal, Mute, Blind, AT Delay em todos) e Ragna Blast (Seal). Esteja protegido antes de ele agir e termine antes da fúria.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

strategy.en: Summons Vogel 235 reinforcements and Photon Laws, and hurts himself with some of his own moves. S-Break the Vogels at the start, then beat him down; he rages below half HP.
strategy.pt: Invoca reforços Vogel 235 e Photon Laws, e se machuca com alguns dos próprios golpes. Use S-Breaks nos Vogels no começo e depois derrube-o; ele entra em fúria com menos da metade do HP.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Ruan

strategy.en: Swordfish moves cause DEF/ADF Down and Deathblow, Samba de Pengu almost always Confuses, and it heals with Snacktime. Buff, burst it down before it rages, and S-Break through its Endure.
strategy.pt: Os golpes Swordfish causam DEF/ADF Down e Deathblow, o Samba de Pengu quase sempre causa Confuse e ele se cura com Snacktime. Reforce os buffs, derrube antes da fúria e use um S-Break para vencer o Endure.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

location.en: Tratt Plains Road — toward Wolf Fort
location.pt: Tratt Plains Road — rumo a Wolf Fort

strategy.en: Unlike the Chapter 2 fight, go all out: Joshua's Phantom Raid with Burst on repeat, then Agate's Final Break II (not Dragon Dive) when out of CP, and Joshua again at 100 CP.
strategy.pt: Ao contrário da luta do Capítulo 2, vá com tudo: Phantom Raid do Joshua com Burst em repetição, depois o Final Break II do Agate (não o Dragon Dive) quando faltar CP, e o Joshua de novo com 100 CP.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

strategy.en: Blade attacks cause Seal, Deathblow and AT Delay, and they rage at 75% and 25% HP. Spam S-Breaks with Burst as in the worm fight; the stronger cougar may be left, so protect yourself then.
strategy.pt: Os golpes de lâmina causam Seal, Deathblow e AT Delay, e eles entram em fúria com 75% e 25% do HP. Use S-Breaks com Burst como na luta das minhocas; o cougar mais forte pode sobrar, então se proteja nessa hora.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Zeiss

strategy.en: S-Break the Lark Cacti, then guard against Pollen Explosion (Poison, Blind, Confuse) and Massive Needlecane (AT Delay, All Cancel, MOV Down). Burst cures ailments if you are hit first.
strategy.pt: Use S-Breaks nos Lark Cacti e depois proteja-se de Pollen Explosion (Poison, Blind, Confuse) e Massive Needlecane (AT Delay, All Cancel, MOV Down). O Burst cura efeitos se você for atingido primeiro.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Grancel

strategy.en: Poison, Blind, Confuse, HP/EP/CP drain and summoned spiders. Their HP is low, so offense beats defense here.
strategy.pt: Poison, Blind, Confuse, drenagem de HP/EP/CP e aranhas invocadas. O HP é baixo, então ataque funciona melhor que defesa.

sources: guide: Neoseeker SC walkthrough, Chapter 8 - Grancel

strategy.en: Narrow arena and only one arts caster. S-Craft the Vogels at the start; the Apaches are fragile and weak to AT Delay and Stat Down.
strategy.pt: Arena estreita e só um conjurador de arts. Use S-Crafts nos Vogels no começo; os Apaches são frágeis e fracos a AT Delay e Stat Down.
